description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the image content safety operation ScanImage
description_zh: 本文介绍图片内容安全ScanImage的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageaudit scan-image --task MaxFrames=1 DataId=uuid-xxxx-xxxx-1234 ImageURL=http://xxx.xxx.com/xxx.jpg ImageTimeMillisecond=1 Interval=1 --scene porn --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScanImage

fields.help_en: The data ID. All IDs must be unique within a single request
fields.help_zh: 数据ID。需要保证在一次请求中所有的ID不重复
fields.name: data_id

fields.help_en: The creation or editing time of the image, in milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 图片创建或编辑时间，单位为毫秒
fields.name: image_time_millisecond

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image to be detected. HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS link outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

If you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region, the system automatically converts the OSS link to an internal network address before downloading the file, so calling this operation does not incur OSS traffic charges
fields.help_zh:
待检测图像的URL地址。支持HTTP和HTTPS协议。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

如果使用上海地域的OSS链接，系统会自动将OSS链接地址转成内网地址然后再下载文件，所以调用该接口并不会产生OSS流量计费
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en:
The frame capture interval, used specifically for GIF or long image detection. A GIF image can be understood as an array of images, and one image is extracted for detection every interval images. Frames are captured from a GIF only when this parameter is specified. Long images support both long vertical images and long horizontal images.

Long vertical images (height greater than 400 pixels, height-to-width ratio greater than 2.5): the total number of images is calculated by rounding down `height/width`, and the image is split accordingly.

Long horizontal images (width greater than 400 pixels, width-to-height ratio greater than 2.5): the total number of images is calculated by rounding down `width/height`, and the image is split accordingly.

By default, only the first frame of a GIF or long image is detected. The interval parameter instructs the backend to skip frames at the specified interval during detection to reduce detection costs. Use this parameter together with the maxFrames parameter. For example, if you set interval to 2 and maxFrames to 100, every other frame is detected when detecting a long image or GIF, up to a maximum of 100 frames. Billing is based on the actual number of frames detected
fields.help_zh:
截帧频率，GIF图或者长图检测专用。GIF图可理解为图片数组，每interval张图片抽取一张进行检测。只有该值存在时，才会对GIF进行截帧。长图同时支持长竖图和长横图。

长竖图（高大于400像素，高宽比大于2.5），会按照`高/宽`取整来计算总图数，并进行切割。

长横图（宽大于400像素，宽高比大于2.5），会按照`宽/高`取整来计算总图数，并进行切割。

默认只会检测GIF图或长图的第一帧，interval参数用于指示后台在检测时可按照该间隔跳着检测，以节省检测成本。需要与maxFrames参数组合使用。例如，设置interval为2，maxFrames为100，检测长图或GIF图时，将每间隔1帧检测一次，最多检测100帧，计费则按照实际检测的数量计算
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of frames to capture, used specifically for GIF or long image detection. Default value: 1.
When interval × maxFrames is less than the total number of images contained in the image, the frame capture interval is automatically adjusted to `total number of images / maxFrames` to improve overall detection accuracy
fields.help_zh:
最大截帧数量，GIF图或长图检测专用，默认值为1。
当interval*maxFrames小于该图片所包含的图片数量时，截帧间隔会自动修改为`该图片所包含的图片数/maxFrames`，以提高整体检测效果
fields.name: max_frames

SubResults.description_en: The detection results for a single image

Frames.description_en: The temporary access addresses of each frame if the image is truncated because it is too long. You can use these addresses for reference
Frames.description_zh: 如果待检测图片因为过长被截断，该参数返回截断后的每一帧图像的临时访问地址供您参考

Rate.description_en: The probability that the result belongs to this category. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates a higher probability of belonging to this category
Rate.description_zh: 结果为该分类的概率，取值范围为0~100。值越高，表示越有可能属于该分类

URL.description_en: The temporary access URL of the truncated image. The URL is valid for 5 minutes
URL.description_zh: 被截断的图片的临时访问URL，地址有效期是5分钟

HintWordsInfoList.description_en:
The risk keyword information matched by the advertisement text in the image when the image contains advertisements. The value is in array format.

This parameter applies only to the ad scene. Example: `"hintWordsInfo":[{"context":"sensitive word"}]`
HintWordsInfoList.description_zh:
图片中含有广告时，返回图片中广告文字命中的风险关键词信息。格式为数组。

仅适用于ad场景。示例值：`”hintWordsInfo”:[{“context”:”敏感词”}]`

Context.description_en: The risk keyword content matched by the text in the image
Context.description_zh: 图片中文字命中的风险关键词内容

Label.description_en: The category of the detection result, which corresponds to a specific scene. For valid values, see the mapping between scene and label
Label.description_zh: 检测结果的分类，与具体的scene对应。取值范围参见scene和label对应关系说明

LogoDataList.description_en:
The logo information identified in the image when the image contains logos.

This parameter applies only to the logo scene
LogoDataList.description_zh:
图片中含有Logo时，返回识别出来的Logo信息。

仅适用于Logo场景

Height.description_en: The height of the logo region

Name.description_en: The name of the identified logo

Type.description_en: The type of the identified logo. The value is TV (channel logo)
Type.description_zh: 识别出的logo类型，取值为TV（台标）

Width.description_en: The width of the logo region

X.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the logo region to the y-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the origin
X.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，Logo区域左上角到y轴距离

Y.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the logo region to the x-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the origin
Y.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，Logo区域左上角到x轴距离

items.description_en: The complete text information recognized in the image
items.description_zh: 识别到的图片中的完整文字信息

ProgramCodeDataList.description_en:
The location information of mini program codes when the image contains mini program codes.

This parameter applies only to the qrcode scene, and you must have enabled mini program code recognition by contacting us through the DingTalk group (23109592)
ProgramCodeDataList.description_zh:
图片中含有小程序码时，返回小程序码的位置信息。

仅适用于qrcode场景，且已通过钉钉群（23109592）联系我们开通了小程序码识别

Height.description_en: The height of the mini program code region

Width.description_en: The width of the mini program code region

X.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the mini program code region to the y-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the origin
X.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，小程序码区域左上角到y轴距离

Y.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the mini program code region to the x-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the origin
Y.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，小程序码区域左上角到x轴距离

Rate.description_en: The probability that the result belongs to this category. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates a higher probability of belonging to this category
Rate.description_zh: 结果为该分类的概率，取值范围为0~100。值越高，表示越有可能属于该分类

Scene.description_en: The image detection scenario, which corresponds to the scenes specified in the request
Scene.description_zh: 图片检测场景，和调用请求中的场景（scenes）对应

SfaceDataList.description_en:
The terrorism-related sensitive information identified in the image when the image contains terrorism-related sensitive content.

This parameter applies only to the terrorism and sface scenes. For details about this parameter in the sface scene, see sensitive face detection
SfaceDataList.description_zh:
图片中包含暴恐敏感内容时，返回识别出来的暴恐敏感信息。

仅适用于terrorism和sface场景。关于该参数在sface场景中的具体内容，请参见敏感人脸检测

Name.description_en: The name of the similar person

Height.description_en: The height of the face region

Width.description_en: The width of the face region

X.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the face region to the y-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the origin
X.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，人脸区域左上角到y轴距离

Y.description_en: The distance from the upper-left corner of the face region to the x-axis, with the upper-left corner of the image as the origin
Y.description_zh: 以图片左上角为坐标原点，人脸区域左上角到x轴距离

Suggestion.description_en:
The recommended action.

pass: The image is normal and no further action is required, or no target object is identified.

review: The detection result is uncertain and manual review is required, or no target object is identified.

block: The image violates the rules. We recommend that you take further action, such as deleting the image or restricting access
Suggestion.description_zh:
建议您执行的操作。

pass：图片正常，无需进行其余操作；或者未识别出目标对象。

review：检测结果不确定，需要进行人工审核；或者未识别出目标对象。

block：图片违规，建议执行进一步操作（如直接删除或做限制处理）
